target.definition: e_v = median_t log( f_AnyCalib(v,t) / f_ref(v) ) for the AnyCalib anycalib_gen radial:2 condition, reused EXACTLY as frozen in CAM-EXP-005
target.why_not_focal_directly: the rig's reference focal has CV 1.90 %, so predicting the focal itself rewards emitting a constant (SINGLE_FOCAL_RIG_CONFOUND)

model.alpha_selection: grouped CV inside the training fold only; the outer test is never consulted

baselines.name: RAW_ANYCALIB
baselines.what: AnyCalib's view focal with no correction

baselines.name: GLOBAL_BIAS_CORRECTED_ANYCALIB
baselines.what: subtract the training folds' median signed log bias; one constant, no per-view information

baselines.name: CAM005_FROZEN_SCENE_BASELINE
baselines.what: CAM-EXP-005's deployable scene-only feature set P6 (scene geometry + image global + border), reused unchanged
baselines.note: CAM-005's P4 and P7 are NOT used: they contain the model's own prediction, which is exactly the confound C1 isolates

baselines.name: TRAINING_FOLD_CONSTANT_REFERENCE_ORACLE
baselines.what: emit the training cameras' median reference focal

comparison_rule: every paired comparison runs on the COMMON hand-feature-eligible view set; results are also reported on the full benchmark

hypotheses.H1: some frozen hand-model explicit output is associated with the AnyCalib residual bias
hypotheses.H2: if that signal is a deployable camera cue it must beat B1 under leave-one-physical-camera-out
hypotheses.H3: simple box/crop/pred_cam cues and the deep latent may carry different amounts of information
hypotheses.H4: if the latent beats the explicit outputs, the network holds a camera/image prior not exposed in its explicit geometry
hypotheses.H5: if real hand-view correspondence matters, real features must beat view-shuffled features
hypotheses.H6: improvement under LOSO but failure under LOCO-camera indicates same-rig repetition rather than a generalisable cue
hypotheses.H7: scene+hand beating scene-only means hand features add information beyond CAM-005's scene cues
hypotheses.H8: if nothing beats B1 and the scene baseline, no usable residual-bias signal was detected in this frozen model

HAND_DERIVED_SIGNAL_PROMISING.condition_1: versus B1: median relative focal error reduced by >= 10 % relative, OR within +-5 % rate up by >= 5 percentage points
HAND_DERIVED_SIGNAL_PROMISING.condition_2: bias-prediction Spearman positive with a stable physical-camera cluster-bootstrap direction; strong form requires the CI lower bound > 0
HAND_DERIVED_SIGNAL_PROMISING.condition_4: the corrected focal is not a constant collapse

SCENE_PLUS_HAND_SIGNAL_PROMISING.condition_1: versus B2 scene-only: >= 10 % relative median error reduction OR +5 pp within +-5 %
SCENE_PLUS_HAND_SIGNAL_PROMISING.condition_2: bias correlation improves in the same direction

LATENT_CAMERA_SIGNAL_PROMISING.condition: a latent-containing group (P6, P7, P9, P10) passes the primary thresholds, beats shuffle, holds under LOCO-camera, and is not a constant collapse

CONSTANT_COLLAPSE.fires_if: median error low AND corrected-focal CV near zero AND no focal tracking
